style.title: Style
style.description: conventional: type(scope): subject. plain: an imperative subject. gitmoji: a gitmoji, then the subject.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the message, for example English or German.

body.title: Body
body.description: auto: a short body only when the change needs explaining. always: subject and body. never: the subject line only.

useDraft.title: Use the text already in the message box as a hint
useDraft.description: When amending, the previous message is always used.

instructions.title: Extra instructions
instructions.description: Added to the prompt, for example: mention the ticket from the branch name; use the scopes api, ui, db.

maxDiffKb.title: Diff sent to the model (KiB)
maxDiffKb.description: From 4 to 1024. Larger diffs are cut; the file list is always sent whole.
